# Exact unittest ids allowed to fail on Homebrew Python 3.15 (issue #7).
# Inside the sandbox, importing ctypes is denied on 3.15 (os.uname()), so these two
# process-inspection probes cannot run. Every other subTest of the same test, and the
# test itself, must still pass. This list is a prediction that CI has not yet confirmed.
test_security.ConfinementTests.test_process_isolation_env_signals_and_inspection (probe='sibling_environment')
test_security.ConfinementTests.test_process_isolation_env_signals_and_inspection (probe='parent_executable')
